420:t_004:18.en:
$$リジット$$
「But everyone in the fleet lives by helping one another. Every single one of us.」

420:t_004:19.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Of course we have disputes and disagreements. But there's no hatred from the heart.」

420:t_004:20.en:
$$桂$$
「I see. You're like one big family.」

420:t_004:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you fight, but you never hate each other.」

420:t_004:22.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That's impossible... Impossible! No such people could exist!!」

420:t_004:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$, if you force situations and enemies into your own assumptions, you're unfit to command.」

420:t_004:24.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You lost because you thought everyone lived in hatred, just like you.」

420:t_004:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「I won't say hatred is evil. It is one of the things that shapes human beings.」

420:t_004:26.en:
$$シン$$
「But listen! There are people in this world who don't have it, and people who've overcome it!」

420:t_004:28.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It seems you have no intention of retreating, even though your trump card has failed.」

420:t_004:29.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I have a reason I cannot retreat!」

420:t_004:31.en:
$$シモン$$
「Today we're settling this for good!」

420:t_005:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our target is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! We'll defeat him here and sweep $$サイデリアル$$ out of the $$残されの海$$!」

420:t_005:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「That's the new Empress of the Sea for you... You're a fine commander.」

420:t_005:2.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll crush them so they can never threaten the fleet again!」

420:t_006:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our target is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! We'll defeat him here and sweep $$サイデリアル$$ out of the $$残されの海$$!」

420:t_006:1.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll crush them so they can never threaten the fleet again!」

420:t_007:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I can't... lose in a place like this...!」

420:t_007:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「You don't know when to give up, $$ギルター$$!」

420:t_007:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Then I'll put an end to your life... for good!」

420:t_008:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you've shown up, $$バルビエル$$!」

420:t_008:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「For someone who received the scorpion's venom from $$サルディアス$$, you haven't achieved much.」

420:t_008:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-no... W-well! P-please forgive me, Lord $$バルビエル$$!」

420:t_008:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Save your pathetic farce for later, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$!」

420:t_008:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you've come here, I'll be your opponent!」

420:t_008:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...It seems you've realized it, $$セツコ$$.」

420:t_008:11.en:
$$シン$$
「What are you talking about, $$セツコ$$!?」

420:t_008:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「While $$ランド$$'s $$スフィア$$ has a favorable match against $$ストラウス$$'s...」

420:t_008:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ has an unfavorable match against mine.」

420:t_008:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To completely defeat an awakened $$スフィア・リアクター$$, you need a $$スフィア$$ with an unfavorable match against theirs...」

420:t_008:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To defeat $$アイム・ライアード$$, the $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アサキム$$ used the $$知りたがる山羊$$ $$スフィア$$.」

420:t_008:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「I see! So $$バルビエル$$ wanted to deal with $$セツコ$$ first because she could defeat him!」

420:t_008:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're surprisingly timid, $$バルビエル$$!」

420:t_008:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't misunderstand, second-rate $$リアクター$$. $$スフィア$$ matchups mean nothing before overwhelming power.」

420:t_008:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Besides, you aren't the ones I want.」

420:t_008:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... I'll ask one last time. Come with us.」

420:t_008:26.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So he's taken the simplest approach.」

420:t_008:27.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If Miss $$スズネ$$ had come onto the battlefield under mind control, we still could have done something...」

420:t_008:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But we can't do anything about this...!」

420:t_008:31.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Are you crushed by despair...? Then I'll give you hope.」

420:t_008:32.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you surrender to us, I'll free $$西条涼音$$ and return an area of your choice to Earth's control.」

420:t_008:34.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let's see... I could also return five people of your choice from among our captives.」

420:t_008:35.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'd recommend $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$, $$ナナリー・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$, or $$マリナ・イスマイール$$.」

420:t_008:39.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Choose, $n. Will it be hope for the future, or despair you can never undo?」

420:t_009:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...That failed. He was less useful than I'd expected.」

420:t_009:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「What did you do to $n, you bastard!?」

420:t_009:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「He drew out his $$スフィア$$'s power through the conflicting feelings of hope and despair...」

420:t_009:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So I fed both of them. ...He couldn't choose either one, and his mind died as a result.」
